latestVersion.changelog:
AI Photo Video 1.0.0 — Launch Version

- Instantly converts uploaded photos into 1080p MP4 videos with music and transitions, ready to post.
- Supports common image formats (JPG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP) up to 200MB.
- No manual editing required — just upload and describe the video you want.
- Designed with simple prompts for fast video creation, showing live progress and clear feedback.
- Handles upload, credits, session management, and export entirely through cloud processing.
